invariants.rationale: execute() of MergeOnReadRollbackActionExecutor is expected to return a HoodieRollbackMetadata instance, which should not be null.
rollbackInstantTime is used as an argument to the action executor and must be supplied to identify the rollback instant.
commitInstant is provided to the action executor and is essential for identifying which instant is to be rolled back.
Resulting object from rollback should be of HoodieRollbackMetadata type.
Rollback metadata generally tracks number of files deleted; this count should not be negative.
